'/x.php') leaves a literal that starts with a slash, which is read as relative to the including file. public = public, protected = package, private = private; no modifier: a member is public (the language default), a top-level function or class exported. abstract: base.m reaches the overrides. protocol: the magic methods and the methods of the SPL / standard interfaces that the engine or a library calls by name. ref_cmd.ref: a string argument of a callback function (call_user_func, array_map, add_action ...) names a function. path_roots: Laravel and Symfony call controllers, commands, providers, middleware, jobs, listeners, policies and migrations by convention (hard), models and views by their methods in templates (soft).
